analysis_type: historical descriptive review; not preregistered prospective testing
strategy: Frozen 50 complete 30-minute bar NQ-equivalent breakout; unchanged; BID CFD/index proxy, not CME NQ

accounting.season_window: entry timestamp from January 1 through July 14 inclusive for each year
subgroups: native fills.csv STOP/MARKET exit order type
accounting.costed_gross_definition: Trade ledger gross_pnl is before commissions but includes modeled fill slippage; zero-cost PnL is reported from the separate zero-cost ledger. Do not label costed gross as zero-cost gross.

market_features.bar_construction: 30 unique one-minute source rows per complete Chicago 17:00-anchored 30-minute interval; same bins as fixed strategy
market_features.causal_feature_availability: Each complete 30m bar releases at bar_start+30m; backward as-of join requires release_time <= entry_time.
features: 50-bar high-low channel width in points and bps
market_features.regime_comparison: Use 2018-2025 Jan 1-Jul 14 entry observations as the reference; report 2026 trade counts, costed net/gross PnL, and win rate by reference-tercile thresholds. Terciles are descriptive, not a trading rule.
market_features.market_context: Daily close-to-close realized volatility and close trend from the same proxy; external reporting only as dated context and hypothesis, never as causal proof.

event_windows: Fixed descriptive tags: 2026-01; 2026-02; 2026-03; 2026-04; 2026-05; 2026-06; 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-14. No post-boundary context.

methods.ledger_processing: Polars group_by aggregations; no backtest rerun
methods.market_feature_engine: ml4t.engineer.compute_features for ATR(20), sorted Polars expressions for causal features, and ml4t.diagnostic.evaluation.drift.compute_psi plus scipy KS for descriptive distribution comparisons. No model fitting or predictive performance claims.
methods.causal_interpretation: Accounting identities are verified. Feature/PnL slices are conditional associations, not identified causal effects. Exclude post-entry MFE/MAE from feature definitions. 1-minute OHLC cannot identify within-minute event ordering.
methods.uncertainty: Report sample sizes and descriptive differences. Do not fabricate confidence intervals if a valid day-cluster bootstrap is not implemented.

workflow_note: The mission asked for bin declaration before outcome inspection. An earlier broad inspection exposed a legacy aggregate report and a phase-567 run metric before this file was written. Those observations are not used as diagnostic inputs. This manifest records the historical-review scope before the relevant annual trade ledgers and source features are analyzed.

supersedes_errors: exit class inferred from generic evaluation_trades.exit_reason
corrective_audit.native_exit_pairing: Pair fills.csv rows by zero-based row index: even rows are entry, odd rows are exit; assert both timestamps against same-index trades.csv; join exit order_type to evaluation_trades by (entry_time, exit_time, direction), one-to-one.
corrective_audit.rth: Convert entry_time with America/Chicago DST rules; RTH is 08:30 inclusive to 15:00 exclusive (510 <= minute_of_day < 900).
corrective_audit.feature_release: A complete 30m bar releases at bar_start+30m. Use a backward as-of join only where feature_available_at <= entry_time.
corrective_audit.fixed_stop_diagnostic: Keep the fixed 50-point stop unchanged. Compare native STOP frequency by 50/pre-entry ATR20 terciles cut on matched Jan 1-Jul 14 2018-2025 trades. Report 2018 full-year and 2026 median prices separately. No threshold selection.
corrective_audit.source_minute_stop_touch: Include entry and exit minute OHLC in the 50-point touch scan; report minute-order ambiguity.
corrective_audit.scope: Historical correction only. No strategy rerun, no rule change, no holdout access, no orders.
